0.content: In the Cataclysm 500 years ago the twin travelers woke in a burning Teyvat and tried to leave for another world. A white-clad god appeared and blocked their path: "Outlanders, your journey ends here." She named herself the sustainer of heavenly principles and declared that "the arrogation of mankind ends now". The twins fought her and lost. Her red-and-black cubes swallowed the sibling and condensed them into a single cube in her hand. When the Traveler reached for them, the cubes engulfed the Traveler too. The Traveler's power was sealed and they fell into a long sleep full of nightmares. They woke in a changed world, alone, and set out to find that god.

1.content: Her private domain floats hidden in the sky above Windrest Peak in Mondstadt. It was once an Arcadian temple to the Master of Space, joined to the Thousand Winds Temple of the Master of Time. After a disaster it rose into the heavens and its shadow was hidden. Only then did Asmoday's gaze fall on it. She remade it into Segment-Domain Tau, a silent watchtower and archive. People, relics and landscapes of vanished civilisations are "uplifted" into it and kept, unchanging. No one there ages or dies, and innovation is forbidden. No wind may enter her hall.

2.content: Asmoday created two Watchers to keep her temple and watch Teyvat in silence. Rumour among the residents says she named them after the two things she could least deal with: nothingness (Nihilita) and melancholy (Melanta). When she disappeared, Nihilita "opened his eye", defied her will and left. Melanta stayed and enforced her original rules with growing cruelty, turning residents into pages, ink blots and sand.

3.content: Asmoday took the sibling in the opening battle. A damaged coffin in the Cage of Suchness is where they once rested; the Traveler senses it there in 6.5. The sibling later became leader of the Abyss Order. Canon does not show how they left her keeping. By 6.5 Melanta believed she had "chosen" the sibling, and in 7.1 she was seen with a hooded figure, whom the wiki identifies as the sibling.

4.content: In the official teaser "The Gods' Limits" (2025-07-09), Ronova, Istaroth and Rhinedottir, attending for Naberius, meet in Celestia without her. Ronova says no Shade has missed a meeting since the Heavenly Principles made them, and wants her found. Istaroth calls the meetings a formality and suggests she simply "switched sides", saying finding her would do more harm than good. Ronova calls that unthinkable for a shadow of the Heavenly Principles, "unless she loves her new master more than her own self".

5.content: In 7.1, meeting Rhinedottir and Naberius, the Tsaritsa Anastasya reported that she had recently seen Asmoday, the Ruler of Space. An unknown monster had brought endless snowstorms into Snezhnaya and grew stronger as it advanced. Anastasya went into the storm alone and found two figures at its heart: a hooded one, and one she was certain was Asmoday. She overheard the hooded figure say the sight was worth witnessing as "the end of the Third Descender's story". The two noticed her, Asmoday used the power of space, and both vanished. Anastasya then killed the half-conscious monster.
